title: 第十九章粮价大跌高阳对人心的把控第20章同进退还是互捅一刀
slug: 我最强毒士女帝直呼活阎王
lines: “利益之下无朋友，临江城粮价的下降乃是大势，谁也阻挡不了。”
淡淡的声音清晰的传至杜江的耳中。
杜江站在原地，只感觉这一番话犹如洪钟大吕一般在他的脑海中响彻。
四大粮商表面上亲密无间，但当危机来袭，真会铁板一片吗？
半晌，他朝着高阳鞠了一个九十度的躬。
“大人一番话，如醍醐灌顶一般，令下官茅塞顿开，下官拜谢大人提点！”
杜江的眼神很纯粹，是发自心底的恭敬。
直到现在，他才明白高阳七天前的那番话。
一切都在他的算计之中。
想降粮价不一定要拼命压低粮价！
张贴榜文勒令临江城的大粮商只准高价卖粮，不准低价卖粮。
一旦临江城的粮价提至天价，外地的商贾因为内心的贪婪，必定纷纷运粮前来，想要大赚一笔。
等外地粮商进一步推高粮价，进来的差不多了，再命县衙开仓放粮，逼这些外地粮商率先抛售，粮价便会顺势暴跌！
最令杜江拍案叫绝的是，高阳开仓放粮的价格不高不低，给了这些外地粮商赚钱的空间。
先抛售的大赚，后抛售的可能破产。
这便会令所有外地粮商互相攀比，都想着最快脱手。
“大人这阳谋，下官佩服！”
上官婉儿也满脸惊叹。
高阳之手段，匪夷所思。
但她好奇道，“要是这些外地粮商不恐慌抛售，那该如何收场？”
高阳看着眼前哄抢的场面，摇了摇头，“这是人性，根本无法抑制，临江城这七日以来，涌入了不少外地粮商。”
“如此多的外地粮商，想法不可能一样，每个人所面对的困境不同，选择便大不相同。”
“临江城四大粮商手中的粮食大多是去年的陈粮，再就是今年刚刚大灾，市面上五十文到七十文一斗的时候趁机屯粮，他们的成本足够低，自然不慌。”
“但这些外地粮商不同，今年整个广阳郡都不好受，粮价一路飞涨，他们有的是倾家荡产想大赚一笔，有的是高价买粮，不远跨越几十公里想来赚差价，光这几十里地的成本，都是一个很恐怖的数字。”
“更别说有的是闲钱买粮，有的是倾家荡产买粮，如此，人心难齐！”
“他们的恐慌抛售，是一件必然的事情。”
高阳顿了顿，似笑非笑的看向上官婉儿道，“若是真的无一人抛售，那本官就以死谢罪，拿这人头向陛下谢罪罢了。”
“脑袋掉了碗大个疤，这算的了什么？”
杜江敬佩道，“大人泰山崩于前而面不改色的心态，下官佩服。”
上官婉儿嘴角一抽，没好气的道，“那高大人为何自从令县衙张贴榜文的那日，便令宫内禁卫随身保护，甚至还内穿一层甲胄？”
“这确定不是防范民愤过大，怕有歹徒刺杀？”
上官婉儿盯着高阳长袍里的内衬，一阵好笑。
她见过怕死的，但没见过向高阳这般怕死的。
绿萝点点头，“不止如此，大公子还令奴婢贴身保护，寸步不离。”
杜江瞪大眼睛，只感觉有什么东西碎了。
高阳大笑几声，掩饰自已的尴尬。
上官婉儿也就算了，毕竟是女帝身边的大红人，他惹不起。
但绿萝居然敢揭他的老底，必须好生教训一二！
他快速转移话题的道，“临江城大势已定，不必再看，坐等粮价暴跌便是。”
说完，高阳迈步离开。
这一次，是这七日以来，高阳第一次率先离去，没有紧贴护卫身旁。
上官婉儿注视着高阳的背影，一张冰冷的眸子泛起点点涟漪。
定国公之孙，倒是有点意思。
content_en:
"There are no friends under interests. The drop in food prices in Linjiang City is a general trend and no one can stop it."
The faint voice reached Du Jiang's ears clearly.
Du Jiang stood there, feeling that these words resounded in his mind like a bell.
On the surface, the four major grain merchants are close to each other, but when a crisis strikes, will they really become monolithic?
After a while, he bowed ninety degrees towards Gao Yang.
"Your Majesty's words are like enlightenment, which makes me enlightened. I thank you for your advice!"
Du Jiang's eyes were pure and respectful from the bottom of his heart.
Only now did he understand what Gao Yang said seven days ago.
Everything is in his calculation.
If you want to lower food prices, you don’t have to fight to keep them down!
A notice was posted ordering the large grain merchants in Linjiang City to sell grain at high prices and not at low prices.
Once the price of food in Linjiang City rises to sky-high prices, merchants from other places will definitely come to transport food one after another because of their greed, hoping to make a big profit.
When foreign grain merchants further push up grain prices and almost all of them have come in, they will order the county government to open warehouses to release grain, forcing these foreign grain merchants to be the first to sell, and grain prices will plummet!
What impressed Du Jiang the most was that the prices for opening grain warehouses in Gaoyang were neither high nor low, giving these foreign grain merchants room to make money.
Those who sell first will make a lot of money, but those who sell later may go bankrupt.
This will make all foreign grain merchants compete with each other and want to get rid of it as quickly as possible.
"My lord, I admire this conspiracy!"
Shangguan Wan'er was also full of surprise.
Gao Yang's methods are unbelievable.
But she asked curiously, "If these foreign grain merchants don't panic sell, how will it end?"
Gao Yang looked at the looting scene in front of him and shook his head, "This is human nature and cannot be suppressed at all. In the past seven days, Linjiang City has seen an influx of grain merchants from other places."
"With so many foreign grain merchants, it is impossible for them to have the same ideas. Everyone faces different difficulties and their choices are very different."
"Most of the grain in the hands of the four major grain merchants in Linjiang City is last year's old grain. Moreover, there has just been a major disaster this year. When the market price is fifty to seventy cents a dou, they take the opportunity to stock up on grain. Their costs are low enough, so they don't panic."
"But these foreign grain merchants are different. The entire Guangyang County is having a hard time this year. Grain prices have been skyrocketing. Some of them are bankrupt and want to make a fortune. Some are buying grain at high prices and traveling dozens of kilometers to make a profit. The cost of just these dozens of miles is a terrifying figure."
"Not to mention that some people have spare money to buy food, and some people spend all their money to buy food. It's hard to unite the hearts of the people!"
"Their panic selling is inevitable."
"Moreover..."
Gao Yang paused, looked at Shangguan Wan'er with a half-smile and said, "If no one really sells, then I will die as an apology and use this head to apologize to Your Majesty."
"I have a big scar on my head. What does that mean?"
Du Jiang said with admiration, "My lord's attitude of not changing his expression despite the collapse of the mountain is admired by my subordinates."
Shangguan Wan'er's mouth twitched and she said angrily, "Then why did Master Gao order the palace guards to protect him and even wear a layer of armor since the day when the county government posted the notice?"
"Are you sure this isn't to prevent excessive public anger and fear of being assassinated by gangsters?"
Shangguan Wan'er stared at the lining of Gao Yang's robe, feeling amused.
She had seen people who were afraid of death, but she had never seen anyone so afraid of death as Xiang Gaoyang.
Luluo nodded, "Not only that, the eldest master also ordered his servants to protect him closely and never leave him."
Du Jiang's eyes widened and he felt like something was broken.
Gao Yang laughed a few times to cover up his embarrassment.
Shangguan Wan'er can forget it, after all, she is a popular person around the empress, and he can't afford to offend her.
But Luluo actually dared to reveal his old background, and he must be taught a lesson!
He quickly changed the topic and said, "The situation in Linjiang City has been decided. There is no need to look any further. Just wait for the price of food to plummet."
After saying that, Gao Yang walked away.
This time, it was the first time in the past seven days that Gao Yang left first and did not stay close to the guard.
Shangguan Wan'er stared at Gao Yang's back, her cold eyes filled with ripples.
The grandson of Duke Dingguo is a bit interesting.
title_en: Chapter 19: The sharp drop in food prices. Gao Yang’s control over people’s hearts. Chapter 20: Advancing and retreating together is stabbing each other.
